column1: # DECLARED EGRESS INVENTORY. host<TAB>purpose<TAB>what it carries
# This is a LEDGER, not a scrape. Each row is a claim we are making in public:
# that this destination exists, that it exists for this reason, and that this
# is what crosses it. Adding a row is making a claim; a reader is entitled to
# check it and we should expect them to.
# THE PROBE DOES NOT TRUST THIS FILE. It resolves these hosts ON THE BOX, IN
# THE SAME SAMPLING LOOP as the socket read, and joins by address. Anything
# observed that does not match a contemporaneously-resolved declared host is
# reported UNATTRIBUTED and loud. So a wrong or missing row makes the probe
# WHY CONTEMPORANEOUS. Resolving afterwards is unsound: on 2026-08-17
# github.com resolved to 20.205.243.166 and then 140.82.114.3 inside the same
# minute. Geo and round-robin DNS mean an address seen at time T cannot be
# attributed by a lookup at T+n. Both halves have to be sampled together.
# STILL NOT PROOF, and the limit is stated rather than buried: a shared CDN
# address can serve thousands of tenants, so a match says "consistent with"
# and never "was". Content is not observed at all. This narrows what an
# unexplained connection could be; it does not certify what an explained one
